arStrings.szText: After Healing for {c_number}[SF_1*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life you afflict Close enemies, dealing {c_number}{dot:POISON_DOT}{/c} Poisoning damage over {c_number}[{buffduration:POISON_DOT}]{/c} seconds and causing them to take {c_number}[SF_6*SF_7*100|x%|]{/c} more Poisoning damage.
